LESSON: ULUM AL- HADITH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al- Hadith
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ulum al- Hadith, part of Hadith in Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What role did the Prophet (S.A.W.) play in the development of Hadith? 2. Why is it important for a Muslim to learn Ulum al- Hadith?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Hadith in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Hadith in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Hadith in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Ulum al- Hadith in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs,

   Ulum al- Hadith helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,

   Ulum al- Hadith helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,

   Ulum al- Hadith helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. value Hadith as a primary source of guidance.

   Ulum al- Hadith helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/from available reference materials on the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs and make a class presentation,

2. discuss the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs in groups and write notes,

3. brainstorm on the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith and share in class,

4. role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/from available reference materials on the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs and make a class presentation,
2. discuss the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs in groups and write notes,
3. brainstorm on the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith and share in class,
4. role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ulum al- Hadith together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: listening and teamwork skills enhanced as learners discuss the development

of Hadith during the Prophet (S.A.W.) and Rightly Guided Caliphs’ time in groups.

• Self-efficacy: Effective communication skills enhanced as learners role-play the methods used by the Prophet

(S.A.W.) to teach Hadith.

• Digital literacy: as learners interact with digital technology as they research online/from available reference materials on

the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs’

time and make a class presentation

Values:
● Integrity enhanced as learners’ research online on the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the

Prophet (S.A.W) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs’ time.

● Love for the Prophet (S.A.W.) as learners role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.)) to teach Hadith.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Good governance is enhanced as learners role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith.

Link to other subjects:

English as learners brainstorm on the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith and share in class.
